liebermann.date: c. 925 (main text); additions c. 1050; the earliest English part 970–1000
liebermann.notes: The Leofric Missal, used by Bishop Leofric (†1072) and given by him to Exeter cathedral, edited by Warren 1883; its core is a Gregorian sacramentary written in Lorraine c. 925, to which the coronation liturgy with the oath (f. 305) belongs.
